title: elymus pauciflorus
intro: Elymus pauciflorus, commonly known as Blue Wildrye, is a type of grass native to North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including the potential to lower cholesterol levels and improve digestion. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and reduce the risk of infections. The bioactive constituents of Elymus pauciflorus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
